title: Palm Releases An Excellence Single Track, "Myself"
htmlContent:
Palm's "Myself" is a soulful track that captures the complexities of self-reflection and growth. The San Diego-based artist delivers a mesmerizing blend of cloud rap, hip-hop, and R&B that showcases his musical versatility. 

"Myself" is a stand-out track from Palm's debut EP "Truzz Me," which has received positive feedback from the local music scene.

Palm's lyrics explore the struggles of finding oneself amidst the chaos of life, with lines like "Feeling lost, but I'm found/ Trying to make sense of the world spinning round." 

The dreamy instrumental, infused with modern classical and trap elements, complements Palm's introspective musings, creating a sonically cohesive experience.

"Myself" is a promising introduction to Palm's independent artist potential and desire to make waves in the industry. With his unique sound and honest lyrics, Palm is an artist to keep an eye on in the future.
